common: Create ONE pixel-art sprite sheet image. Same characters as the attached reference sprites (one reference image per character, given in the same left-to-right order as listed below): identical face, hair, outfit, palette, outline and pixel size/scale. Draw each one SITTING on an invisible chair, seen from a diagonal-front 3/4 view (body turned toward the viewer, head turned slightly toward the right), hands resting forward on an unseen desk/keyboard, knees and legs visible only as a short seat-level silhouette cut off just below the hips/thighs. No chair, no desk, no shadow, no text, no props held except what is unavoidable. One single row of {n} characters with wide gaps between them, each about the same size, on a flat solid #FF00FF magenta background; do not use magenta inside the characters. Save the final image as {out} in the current directory.
